Holly shit, what has been going on in the #Redump community lately. You don't check in on it for the summer and it basically shits itself violently.

Wtf?!? The project apparently split in redump[.]org (the original one) and a new redump[.]info

And when doing so they defaced and deleted a bunch of the stuff on redump[.]org?!?

WTF?!?
